title: RAW one literal o-family operation exposes a written context argument while retaining a default-bound kernel
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. All four whole-f85 ZL/IT pairs dar/odar, tedy/otedy, tchedy/otchedy and chedy/ochedy must share one parameter-exposure law. Retain a context-indexed kernel, not an evaluated base value; no free wrapper table,581 meaning transfer or genitive repair.

design.author_role: bounded independent predecessor/proposal review; root owns selection
design.unknown: Can one fixed parameter-exposure construction own actual source-qualified uses of at least two distinct kernels, while all four literal pairs and their complete surrounding units remain consistently parsed with substantially fewer free family-output meanings?

target_scope.contract: Whole .1–.24 in numeric order; all473 original fields and literal variants remain obligations. No chosen target subphrase replaces the whole scope.

cuts.scope: Only the finite listed literal pairs are decomposed. No universal o deletion, ot segmentation, or normalization is claimed. Unpaired o-initial words remain whole obligations, with no freely fitted residual on a declared pair.

source_program.basis: The already owned64-verse physician speech; source content only, not581 vocabulary or grammar.
prospective_synopsis: Changing yearly conditions and bodily natures.
A modal temporal benefit/harm contrast; same generic input is selected as an explicit interpretation, while the time-itself reading remains a rival.
A shared generic input can be good for one sick/healthy recipient context and harm another; class polarity, material dose, named medicine and one fixed patient are not supplied.
Undirected old/young variation with cold/heat and the need for judgment/context-appropriate conduct.
source_program.limit: A separate source-inspired synopsis, not full64-verse equivalence or repair of581/577/558/original532. The four duties do not imply four target blocks or a figure mapping. Root must approve this prospective source program before a writer.
source_program.wind_comparator_not_adopted: 582 Md2 west paragraph states cold/moist by nature, warm here, warm-land traversal explaining local warmth, and no harm to us. Both nature and here are explicit qualifiers. It does not independently establish an unmarked nature default or a second context-varied humidity statement. Entire13v–14r source tensions remain in its own report; no wind-name/layout inference is imported.

sorts: Args_i (a declared finite product for each of four distinct base kernels)
Meaning_i (explicitly declared output sort, no silent truth/entity/predicate casts)
interface_proposal.one_common_context_interface: One Context interface is declared in the first contract. If it uses tagged temporal/recipient cases, tags and allowed kernel domains must be fixed and charged. No per-occurrence coercion, hidden owner or newly invented context field is allowed.
interface_proposal.base_semantics: Each base denotes ImplicitPackage(F_i), retaining the same fully specified context-indexed kernel F_i. It is NOT merely the already evaluated value F_i(default,args). No kernel or source value is assigned to any target root by this RAW card.
interface_proposal.o_semantics: O(ImplicitPackage(F_i)) = ExplicitPackage(F_i). The kernel and its ordinary argument roles are unchanged. The derived o-form has no independently adjustable whole meaning.
interface_proposal.realize_bare: Realize(ImplicitPackage(F_i), written_args, env) = F_i(env.current_context, written_args). Fail or remain unbound if the explicit binder has not supplied a compatible Context.
interface_proposal.realize_prefixed: Realize(ExplicitPackage(F_i), written_context, written_args, env) = F_i(written_context, written_args). It consumes one additional overt Context expression and does NOT update env.current_context.
interface_proposal.default_binder_policy: Page starts with no default. An overt lexical context opener plus a written context expression binds the active default; only an overt set/close operation changes or ends it. No image, paragraph, convenient nearest noun or line-start creates a default. The actual opener/closer forms and all scope/argument productions must be frozen in the first author contract before remaining whole values. A later bare family use after an explicit o-use still sees the previous default unless a separate written update occurs.
interface_proposal.refs: Written ContextRef and entity/reference values must have separate denotation and resolution laws. O cannot create a named context from a name-neutral descriptor or infer an ultimate owner from a predicate.
interface_proposal.arity: Each kernel has one fixed finite ordinary argument signature. The o-form adds exactly the one Context expression relative to its base realization. Syntax/order and any higher-order predicate conjunction must be predeclared, not inserted after an adjacent family head fails.

required_actual_multiuse: At least two distinct base kernels must each have an actually derived bare application under an overt default and an actually derived prefixed application with a written context, retaining the same ordinary argument roles.
All four ZL/IT base/result pairs are obligatory under the same O law; third/fourth pairs may not be waived as decorative forms or given free residual glosses.
Use different explicitly written contexts in the derived applications and retain their owners/qualifiers in the recovered source content. No unused Context record counts.
A later bare use must expose the no-update consequence of the written-explicit form; otherwise context-replacement/carry and exposure remain unseparated.

The first contract must give concrete kernel definitions and source-linked output consequences. Four unrelated uninterpreted F_i tables, root-ID dispatch, or arbitrary unary interpolation do not satisfy this requirement.

To claim separation from a context-ignoring/constant rival, own a source-qualified output distinction under an explicitly declared respect. Positive GOOD in one context and HARM in another alone need not logically exclude both predicates holding everywhere. Any exclusive/net-assessment assumption must be stated and charged, not silently inferred.
design.identity_law: For every declared base i and compatible written args a, if the explicit context equals the active default, the bare and prefixed applications have the same kernel result F_i(c,a). For another context, the difference must be exactly F_i(c_new,a), with no changed subject, relation, modality, or renamed event.
design.inverse_obstruction: An already evaluated base is insufficient: two functions may agree at default c0 but differ at c1. A unary function of that evaluated value cannot recover which extension is intended. Retaining the kernel is an explicit extra representation commitment, not an inverse operation proven from the string.
necessary_local_audit: dar chedy at S.15 consists of two declared base forms; neither may be silently cast from a predicate package into an entity argument.
Annular otchedy olkaiin odar includes another declared prefixed form in the nearby argument region; its actual typed tree must account for it, not skip it.
E.9 tchedy otedy and all annotated/alternate occurrences are simultaneous obligations.
Whether these produce a contradiction depends on the frozen signatures and productions, not on adjacency alone.

costs.initial_independent_ZL_family_bindings: Four base kernels plus one O operation, compared with eight unrelated whole bindings: at most three fewer primitive lexical choices before interface/syntax costs. This is not a demonstrated whole-page economy.
additional_costs: Kernel-retaining package types and realization policies
Common Context interface and any tagged subcases
Every required source interpretation, whole meaning outside family, and synonym
All higher-order constructions, modal distinctions, resets and literal alternate gaps
costs.prohibition: No source-irrelevant near-synonyms, hidden per-base O branches or extra residual payload may be used to claim compression. Actual total costs must be compared, not just the five-item family headline.

design.readiness: Suitable only for a bounded first-contract attempt after root selection. Paid working meanings are permitted; prior semantic confirmation is not a prerequisite. Actual common interface, binders, kernel definitions and source-output consequences are still required before whole authoring.
design.stop_rule: If no two actual kernel/default/explicit applications can be owned under the frozen first interface, retain a concrete partial and stop. Do not add an unrestricted wrapper table, alias marked forms, silently change a kernel/signature, expand target access or continue a generic dictionary.
